title: Jammy Creamy Russian Christmas Pudding Pudding
description: A delicious and creamy meal-prep dish featuring Christmas pudding, perfect for a low-calorie-friendly Russian Christmas dinner. Serve in individual serving bowls or a large tagliere.

ingredients.name: Granulated sugar
ingredients.notes: you can reduce this to 10g if you prefer less sweet

ingredients.name: Vitamin C
ingredients.notes: optional, but recommended for a healthier dish

ingredients.name: Vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: a few drops, not too much

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine Christmas pudding, Greek yogurt, raspberry jam, granulated sugar, all-purpose flour, egg, milk, vitamin C, and vanilla extract. Mix until smooth and creamy.
Taste the mixture and adjust the sweetness and flavor as needed.
Pour the mixture into individual serving bowls or a large tagliere, depending on your preference.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld together.
Before serving, sprinkle with a pinch of salt to bring out the flavors.
Serve chilled, garnished with fresh berries or a drizzle of honey, if desired,
Serve as a dessert or a snack, depending on your preference.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Before reheating, make sure to refrigerate the pudding at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Reheat the pudding in the microwave or oven until warmed through, checking every 30 seconds to avoid overcooking.
